pu: Packing Unit: one selling unit, what the customer buys. If the screen asks for 14 PU, that is 14 single products.
tote: The blue plastic box (bak) in which you place the repacked product.
tote_id: The number of the tote. You scan it from the label on the bak and it must match the one on screen.
pu_carton: How many units a carton of unprocessed articles contains.
qty_repack: The units of this article that still have to be repacked.
damaged: The units you have reported as damaged with F1.
manco: Missing stock: the pallet brings fewer units than the system asks for. The supervisor reports it with F7.
pallet_id: The number of the pallet you are working on. Check that it matches the label on the real pallet.
tara: Weighing of the empty tote. The system needs it to calculate later how many units are inside.
worklist: The list of steps on the left of the screen. The step you are in is highlighted in green.
